entries.title: blender-looks
entries.summary: Lit, atmospheric looks for Blender videos and animations: rainy night, fog with light shafts, sunbeams, neon interior, night city, golden hour, blue hour, overcast, studio or wet product.

entries.title: blender-previs-to-photoreal-style-transfer
entries.summary: Turn a scene idea into a shotlist and Blender previs blockout, then restyle it into photoreal live action with an AI video-editing model, keeping cameras, cuts and timing. For testing or pitching an action scene before shooting it.

entries.title: blender-sets
entries.summary: Build big Blender sets (forest, city block, downtown, street, market, valley) with a camera path, and scatter scenery (plants, rocks, debris or your own models) on a surface. Use with edit-in-blender for large environments.

entries.title: brand-kit
entries.summary: Brand kits, saved design directions and company logos.

entries.title: cad-to-cinematic-product-animation-blender
entries.summary: Turn a supplied CAD assembly into a CAD-accurate cinematic product film in Blender: real joint motion, an exploded view, shallow-focus close-ups, titles and music. For a product animation that stays true to the engineering model.

entries.title: choose-media-model
entries.summary: Choose or compare fal media models for best/latest requests, unusual operations, missing defaults, or watching/listening to a clip.

entries.title: cinematic-car-film-blender-original-score
entries.summary: Make a short cinematic car film in Blender (any car, road or location) with fast multi-angle coverage, real-camera-style moves and an original score composed to the cuts. For a car commercial, hero spot or car film made in 3D.

entries.title: composite-3d-object-into-live-action-blender
entries.summary: Build a realistic 3D object (vehicle, airship, prop, creature) and composite it into live-action or generated footage in Blender, matched to the camera move, light and atmosphere. For a VFX insert or CG object shot.

entries.title: conversation-collaboration
entries.summary: Collaborate with separate Voyager chats when authorized; read before chats_* calls or handling their work.

entries.title: critique-track
entries.summary: Critique tracks and mixes against references.

entries.title: custom-connectors
entries.summary: Create, repair or remove personal service connectors.

entries.title: develop-unreal
entries.summary: Drive Unreal Engine projects directly: build, run editor Python on levels and assets, C++ or Blueprints, and render Level Sequences. No MCP server needed.

entries.title: edit-in-blender
entries.summary: Control Blender directly with its Python API: build, light, edit and render .blend scenes with tested look, camera and reference-matching recipes; import models and materials. Use for any Blender work, even with project instructions. No add-on or MCP server needed.

entries.title: edit-in-effectcraft
entries.summary: OSS headless After Effects alternative.

entries.title: edit-in-fframes
entries.summary: Rust/SVG video framework.

entries.title: edit-in-lightcraft
entries.summary: Batch-develop camera raw photos with exposure, color and lens adjustments. Use when LightCraft is requested or the project already uses it.

entries.title: edit-in-photocraft
entries.summary: OSS headless Photoshop alternative. PSD/PSB.

entries.title: edit-in-tesseract
entries.summary: Layered .tsrct video and motion.

entries.title: edit-in-vectorcraft
entries.summary: Open, edit and convert Illustrator, EPS and SVG artwork without Illustrator. Use when VectorCraft is requested or the project already uses it.

entries.title: edit-video
entries.summary: Find, cut and finish local footage; transcript edits, captions, reframing, grading and audio.

entries.title: figma
entries.summary: Extract Figma assets and design details from links, .fig/.deck files or copied selections. Not for new designs or brand kits.

entries.title: find-samples
entries.summary: Find matching samples in local libraries.

entries.title: fpv-drone-flythrough-blender
entries.summary: Build a fast, multi-cut FPV drone flythrough of a landmark, building, city or landscape in Blender, preview every shot at true frame rate, then final-render the approved shots locally or on Voyager GPUs.

entries.title: gpu-machines
entries.summary: Run heavy or CUDA-only work on Voyager GPUs (remote machines) - long renders, simulations, training, model inference, live previews - and reconnect to, snapshot, pause or resume that work. Not for quick local work.

entries.title: make-ai-video
entries.summary: Generate clips, ads and commercials, animate images, restyle footage, storyboard and assemble films.

entries.title: make-announcement-video
entries.summary: Short company news and milestone motion posts without product screens; a launch video from product screenshots or recordings is make-product-demo.

entries.title: make-deck
entries.summary: Slides and presentations; PPTX or PDF.

entries.title: make-design
entries.summary: Static layouts, posters, social graphics, logos and drawn illustrations.

entries.title: make-game
entries.summary: Build, change and playtest desktop games in Godot, LÖVE, Pygame, Bevy, Defold or GameMaker.

entries.title: make-image
entries.summary: Generate or edit standalone images; upscale, cutout and vectorize.

entries.title: make-motion-graphics
entries.summary: Editable motion graphics, animated type, explainers, charts, captions and overlays.

entries.title: make-music
entries.summary: Compose or revise original tracks, beats, loops, songs and video scores.

entries.title: make-product-demo
entries.summary: Software walkthroughs, tutorials, app promos, launch videos and interactive demos from real product UI, screenshots or recordings; recording optional.

entries.title: make-social-loop
entries.summary: Seamless social loops, GIFs, stickers and ambient backgrounds.

entries.title: make-sound
entries.summary: Sound effects and video soundtrack mixing.

entries.title: make-web-game
entries.summary: Build and playtest browser games with three.js, Phaser, PixiJS, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas or KAPLAY.

entries.title: make-x-game
entries.summary: Playable browser games for X posts and player cards.

entries.title: mini-flows
entries.summary: Chained media generations and variants with intermediate choices in the Flows panel.

entries.title: publish-game
entries.summary: Publish, update or unpublish static HTML/JavaScript games on voyager.site.

entries.title: publish-to-itch
entries.summary: Upload game builds with butler.

entries.title: publish-video
entries.summary: Publish, draft or schedule videos on YouTube and TikTok; check existing posts.

entries.title: room-to-video
entries.summary: Reconstruct real rooms from photos/video; editable Blender camera paths and generated walkthroughs.

entries.title: screen-capture
entries.summary: Record screen, window, camera and audio with editable cursor telemetry; style presenter camera tracks.

entries.title: talking-character-launch-video
entries.summary: Make a short social launch or announcement video where characters talk through a product or feature: one dialogue track, lip-synced AI video shots, on-screen text and motion graphics. For a fun feature, partner or product announcement.

entries.title: use-computer
entries.summary: Operate app interfaces for steps without an integration or browser tool.

entries.title: use-pixellab
entries.summary: Pixel-art sprites, animations and tilesets.

entries.title: video-styles
entries.summary: Style guides for named or stylized video looks.

entries.title: voiceover
entries.summary: Cast and generate narration; clean, repair, mix and deliver audio recordings.

entries.title: voyager-setup
entries.summary: Troubleshoot CLI setup, sign-in, workspaces, desktop companion and managed skills.

entries.title: widgets
entries.summary: Interactive cards in the chat: let the user pick, approve or review media and settings, or explain, visualize and animate.
